underdog.heading: Why Troy can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 +5.6 to p90 +49.6 for Missouri, so a projection of +28.6 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
